headlines.name: Marked.Survivor.hybrid_bound
headlines.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype X] [inst_1 : Fintype Y] (π : X → ℝ) (K : X → X → ℝ) (A : X → Y → ℝ)
  (y₀ : Y) (ε : ℝ),
  Marked.Survivor.IsProbability π →
    Marked.Survivor.IsMarkov K →
      Marked.Survivor.IsTerminal A →
        Marked.Survivor.bind π K = π →
          Marked.Survivor.SurvivorMixing π K ε →
            ∀ (R : ℕ) (μ : X → ℝ),
              (∀ (x : X), 0 ≤ μ x ∧ μ x ≤ π x) →
                Marked.Survivor.tv (Marked.Survivor.bind μ (Marked.Survivor.output K A y₀ (R + 1)))
                    (Marked.Survivor.bind μ (Marked.Survivor.output (Marked.Survivor.refresh π) A y₀ (R + 1))) ≤
                  ↑R * ε

headlines.name: Marked.Survivor.refresh_output_law
headlines.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype X] [inst_1 : Fintype Y] (π : X → ℝ) (A : X → Y → ℝ) (ν : Y → ℝ) (y₀ : Y)
  (s : ℝ),
  Marked.Survivor.IsProbability π →
    Marked.Survivor.IsProbability ν →
      (Marked.Survivor.bind π A = fun y => s * ν y) →
        ∀ (R : ℕ),
          Marked.Survivor.bind π (Marked.Survivor.output (Marked.Survivor.refresh π) A y₀ R) = fun y =>
            (1 - (1 - s) ^ R) * ν y + (1 - s) ^ R * Marked.Survivor.point y₀ y

headlines.name: Marked.Survivor.burn_once_bound
headlines.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype X] [inst_1 : Fintype Y] (α π : X → ℝ) (K : X → X → ℝ) (A : X → Y → ℝ)
  (ν : Y → ℝ) (y₀ : Y) (s ε : ℝ),
  Marked.Survivor.IsProbability π →
    Marked.Survivor.IsProbability ν →
      Marked.Survivor.IsMarkov K →
        Marked.Survivor.IsTerminal A →
          Marked.Survivor.bind π K = π →
            (Marked.Survivor.bind π A = fun y => s * ν y) →
              s ≤ 1 →
                Marked.Survivor.SurvivorMixing π K ε →
                  ∀ (R : ℕ),
                    Marked.Survivor.tv (Marked.Survivor.bind α (Marked.Survivor.output K A y₀ (R + 1))) ν ≤
                      Marked.Survivor.tv α π + (1 - s) ^ (R + 1) + ↑R * ε

headlines.name: Marked.Survivor.dominated_centered_energy
headlines.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype X] (π g : X → ℝ),
  Marked.Survivor.IsProbability π →
    (∀ (x : X), 0 ≤ g x ∧ g x ≤ 1) → (Marked.Survivor.energy π fun x => g x - Marked.Survivor.mean π g) ≤ 1 / 4

headlines.name: Marked.Survivor.survivor_mixing_of_centered_l2
headlines.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype X] (π : X → ℝ) (K : X → X → ℝ) (ρ : ℝ),
  Marked.Survivor.IsProbability π →
    (∀ (x : X), 0 < π x) →
      Marked.Survivor.IsMarkov K →
        Marked.Survivor.IsReversible π K →
          0 ≤ ρ → Marked.Survivor.CenteredL2Contraction π K ρ → Marked.Survivor.SurvivorMixing π K (ρ / 4)

headlines.name: Marked.Survivor.burn_once_l2_bound
headlines.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype X] [inst_1 : Fintype Y] (α π : X → ℝ) (K : X → X → ℝ) (A : X → Y → ℝ)
  (ν : Y → ℝ) (y₀ : Y) (s ρ : ℝ),
  Marked.Survivor.IsProbability π →
    (∀ (x : X), 0 < π x) →
      Marked.Survivor.IsProbability ν →
        Marked.Survivor.IsMarkov K →
          Marked.Survivor.IsTerminal A →
            Marked.Survivor.IsReversible π K →
              (Marked.Survivor.bind π A = fun y => s * ν y) →
                0 ≤ ρ →
                  Marked.Survivor.CenteredL2Contraction π K ρ →
                    ∀ (R : ℕ),
                      Marked.Survivor.tv (Marked.Survivor.bind α (Marked.Survivor.output K A y₀ (R + 1))) ν ≤
                        Marked.Survivor.tv α π + (1 - s) ^ (R + 1) + ↑R * (ρ / 4)

headlines.name: Marked.Survivor.spaced_terminal_bound
headlines.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype X] [inst_1 : Fintype Y] (α π : X → ℝ) (K : X → X → ℝ) (A : X → Y → ℝ)
  (ν : Y → ℝ) (y₀ : Y) (s ρ δ₀ : ℝ),
  Marked.Survivor.IsProbability π →
    (∀ (x : X), 0 < π x) →
      Marked.Survivor.IsProbability ν →
        Marked.Survivor.IsMarkov K →
          Marked.Survivor.IsTerminal A →
            Marked.Survivor.IsReversible π K →
              (Marked.Survivor.bind π A = fun y => s * ν y) →
                0 ≤ ρ →
                  Marked.Survivor.CenteredL2Contraction π K ρ →
                    Marked.Survivor.tv α π ≤ δ₀ →
                      ∀ (R : ℕ),
                        0 < R →
                          Marked.Survivor.tv (Marked.Survivor.bind α (Marked.Survivor.output K A y₀ R)) ν ≤
                            δ₀ + (1 - s) ^ R + ↑(R - 1) * (ρ / 4)
